sentences.en: He overfilled his washing machine with towels.
sentences.zh: 他把毛巾装得太多，超载了洗衣机。

sentences.en: If your life is overfilled with stuff you may need to set some limits.
sentences.zh: 如果你的生活被过多的东西填满，你可能需要设定一些限制。

sentences.en: Be careful not to overfill the kettle; it has a mark showing the maximum water level.
sentences.zh: 小心不要把水壶装得太满，上面有个标记显示最大水量。
